summary.zh: 判断技术债、架构方向与团队扩张
summary.en: Decide on tech debt, architecture bets, and engineering team growth.

description.zh: 针对技术债要不要还、该重写还是重构、架构怎么选以及工程团队如何扩张给出判断依据。适合技术投入需要向上汇报，或团队规模要跨台阶时使用。会结合 DORA 指标评估研发效率。
description.en: Weighs in on paying down tech debt, rewriting versus refactoring, and how to scale the engineering team. Use it when a technical bet needs a defensible case or when headcount has to grow. Grounds the discussion in DORA metrics.
